scripts.sync-assets: rm -rf src/assets && mkdir -p src/assets && cp -a assets/. src/assets/
scripts.dev: npm run sync-assets && python3 scripts/generate_api_docs.py && python3 scripts/generate_llm_manifest.py && npm run fix-links && python3 scripts/validate_docs.py && astro dev
scripts.build: npm run sync-assets && python3 scripts/generate_api_docs.py && python3 scripts/generate_llm_manifest.py && PHENOME_DOCS_STRICT_LINKS=1 npm run fix-links && python3 scripts/validate_docs.py && astro build && python3 scripts/validate_docs.py --dist dist
